name: python-frontend
body: The Python frontend: a standalone Rust binary `pyfrontend` under src/pylib, built on Astral's `ty` type-checker engine with Ruff parser crates pinned as git deps (ruff tag 0.16.6) — no Python runtime at scan time. It discovers __init__.py/__init__.pyi packages plus flat top-level modules, emits module/file/struct/function records and contains/calls/uses edges through `ty`'s project semantics, and emits unresolved_call/unresolved_use -> UnresolvedTarget with a category for anything `ty` cannot resolve. It fits the frontend contract: full `ty` project context, targeted emission, and its native ty/salsa incremental cache. Its source (src/pylib) does not exist yet and is not in the scanned graph, so this component carries NO implemented-by edge — the plan declares it as planned Implementation nodes, the same state as solution.component.js-ts-frontend and solution.component.markdown-frontend.
